about: The standing search list: one PubMed Central open-access query per topic. Scouts work a topic in batches until its hits are all screened (the topic runs dry), then the next. `hits` is the query's count when last run; `screened` the hits a scout has triaged; `queued` the papers sent to readers. Papers read are counted from corpus/findings and corpus/refusals. A topic's found count is the larger of its hits and its screened records (a worked topic was searched with several queries; its query here is the main one).

topics.name: insulin after a meal
topics.why: Insulin after mixed, fat and protein meals in healthy adults; the model predicted it far too low.
topics.query: (postprandial[Title] OR meal[Title] OR breakfast[Title]) AND insulin[Title] AND healthy[All Fields] AND (crossover[All Fields] OR randomized[All Fields] OR randomised[All Fields])

topics.name: meals equal in grams, different in kind
topics.why: Fibre, fat type, protein source, sugars and food form at matched grams, for the meal reader.
topics.query: (fibre[Title] OR fiber[Title] OR whey[Title] OR casein[Title] OR "olive oil"[Title] OR saturated[Title] OR fructose[Title] OR sucrose[Title] OR liquid[Title] OR juice[Title] OR "protein source"[Title] OR "resistant starch"[Title]) AND (postprandial[Title] OR glycemic[Title] OR glycaemic[Title] OR insulin[Title]) AND healthy[All Fields] AND insulin[All Fields]

topics.name: oral glucose tolerance test
topics.why: The canonical test the model's states already cover; glucose, insulin, C-peptide over 2-3 h in healthy adults.
topics.query: ("oral glucose tolerance test"[Title] OR OGTT[Title] OR "glucose load"[Title] OR "glucose ingestion"[Title]) AND healthy[All Fields] AND insulin[All Fields]

topics.name: fasting, overnight to several days
topics.why: Glucose, insulin, fatty acids, ketones and glucagon as a fast lengthens.
topics.query: (fasting[Title] OR fast[Title] OR "time-restricted"[Title]) AND (insulin[All Fields] AND glucose[All Fields]) AND healthy[All Fields] AND ("36 h"[All Fields] OR "48 h"[All Fields] OR "72 h"[All Fields] OR prolonged[Title] OR extended[Title])

topics.name: intravenous glucose and clamps
topics.why: IVGTT and clamp studies the format already reads (infusion and clamp operators).
topics.query: ("intravenous glucose tolerance"[Title] OR IVGTT[Title] OR clamp[Title] OR "hyperglycemic clamp"[Title] OR "euglycemic"[Title]) AND healthy[All Fields] AND insulin[All Fields]

topics.name: a bout of exercise
topics.why: Glucose, lactate, fatty acids, heart rate and cortisol during and after one session.
topics.query: (exercise[Title] OR cycling[Title] OR running[Title] OR "physical activity"[Title]) AND (acute[Title] OR single[Title] OR bout[Title]) AND (glucose[All Fields] AND lactate[All Fields]) AND healthy[All Fields]
topics.note: Re-screened by reading every dropped record after the first pass dropped most by keyword; 36 more kept.

topics.name: sleep loss and timing
topics.why: Sleep restriction or deprivation and meal timing against glucose, insulin and cortisol.
topics.query: ("sleep restriction"[Title] OR "sleep deprivation"[Title] OR "sleep loss"[Title] OR "circadian misalignment"[Title] OR "night shift"[Title]) AND (glucose[All Fields] AND insulin[All Fields]) AND healthy[All Fields]

topics.name: heart and circulation
topics.why: Heart rate and blood pressure responses to meals, posture, exercise and stress.
topics.query: ("blood pressure"[Title] OR "heart rate"[Title] OR haemodynamic[Title] OR hemodynamic[Title]) AND (postprandial[Title] OR meal[Title] OR "head-up tilt"[Title] OR "orthostatic"[Title]) AND healthy[All Fields]

topics.name: stress and cortisol
topics.why: Cortisol and its daily rhythm, and the response to a stressor.
topics.query: (cortisol[Title]) AND ("diurnal"[Title] OR awakening[Title] OR "stress test"[Title] OR TSST[Title] OR rhythm[Title]) AND healthy[All Fields]
